scopes.activation: Enabled for selection after planning dependencies finish; no money or tracking.
Enable after M2 with recorded milestone evidence; refine just in time.
Enable after M3; complete T10.01 before any commercial integration.
Enable after M2 plus a recorded measured need/budget; select only one relevant slice.

milestones.title: Planning ready
milestones.entry: Intent and current repository state checked.
milestones.exit: Reviewed plan and validated tracker with publication-safe evidence.

milestones.title: Fixture-only reader prototype
milestones.entry: M0 complete; source-feasibility go/no-go before substantial contracts/UI work.
milestones.exit: Deterministic offline models, grouping and accessible static reading pass.

milestones.title: Daily supervised noncommercial public pilot
milestones.entry: M1 complete and pilot sources/brand cleared.
milestones.exit: M1 plus all mandatory M2 tasks, real deployment, named daily supervision, rollback and next-cycle evidence pass. Unattended operation is not claimed.

milestones.title: Audience and workload validation
milestones.entry: M2 complete; baseline is collected over at least four weeks before exit.
milestones.exit: Original value, approved measurement, baseline and one engagement experiment reviewed.

milestones.title: First revenue experiment validated
milestones.entry: M3 plus commercial/provider/privacy decisions before integration.
milestones.exit: One support experiment evaluated after fees, cash costs and operator time; keep/stop decision.

milestones.title: Selective extension opportunities
milestones.entry: M2 and specific measured need; choose one later task.
milestones.exit: Portfolio marker, not a release gate: selected task gets its own evidence/rollback; not every future idea must ship.

epics.title: Planning and evidence-driven execution
epics.objective: A reviewed, testable plan with truthful progress.

epics.title: Repository, toolchain, and governance
epics.objective: Safe public collaboration and reproducible development.

epics.title: Source approval and versioned contracts
epics.objective: Small approved source set and stable producer/consumer contracts.

epics.title: Bounded feed collection and normalization
epics.objective: Cheap, polite, secure RSS/Atom collection with honest coverage.

epics.title: Durable state and pipeline recovery
epics.objective: Complete replayable state, safe persistence, and recovery.

epics.title: Identity, story grouping, and editorial trust
epics.objective: Less repetition without losing perspectives or provenance.

epics.title: Minimalist static reader experience
epics.objective: Attractive, accessible, fast reading without required JavaScript.

epics.title: CI, scheduled automation, publishing, and monitoring
epics.objective: A daily protected release pipeline that fails safely.

epics.title: Security, UX, and live pilot release
epics.objective: Demonstrated readiness, not completion inferred from green unit tests.

epics.title: Original value and audience validation
epics.objective: Measure useful repeat readership and operator workload before growth.

epics.title: Gated support and commercial experiments
epics.objective: One reversible, disclosed, measurable revenue channel at a time.

epics.title: Evidence-led extensions and scale
epics.objective: Optional modular improvements only when demand or limits justify them.

tasks.title: Deliver the reviewed planning pack and progress tooling
tasks.deliverable: Versioned roadmap, component specs, complete backlog, deterministic tracker and evidence.
acceptance: Every component has owned tasks, dependencies, subtasks and measurable done criteria.
Planning and product progress are separate; disabled work cannot block the MVP or appear ready.

subtasks.title: Define architecture, UX, safety and phased business gates
subtasks.done_when: Specifications and roadmap cover the smallest launch and safe extension seams.

subtasks.title: Encode epics, tasks, subtasks, dependencies and progress
subtasks.done_when: Canonical backlog and generated views validate and agree.

subtasks.title: Review, test and check publication safety
subtasks.done_when: Independent review has no blocker; named checks and safe evidence are recorded.

tasks.title: Establish public repository rules and reporting
tasks.deliverable: Protected main, PR templates, private vulnerability reporting, public-safe issue guidance and ownership.
acceptance: Required PR/check rules protect main without automation bypass.
A fork contribution needs no secret; reporting route never invites public disclosure of credentials.

subtasks.title: Configure rules and required-check strategy
subtasks.done_when: Actual account-tier rules are documented and enforced on main.

subtasks.title: Set contributor and sensitive-reporting paths
subtasks.done_when: Templates and private reporting route are usable without publishing secrets.

subtasks.title: Exercise branch/fork behavior
subtasks.done_when: Test PR and blocked direct-write evidence is recorded.

tasks.title: Create reproducible Python and local check setup
tasks.deliverable: uv-managed package, locked minimal dependencies, ruff, unittest/fixture check entry points.
acceptance: Fresh clone installs with the lockfile and runs fixture tests without production credentials.
Make help describes real available targets; no unnecessary runtime framework or service.

subtasks.title: Initialize package and supported Python version
subtasks.done_when: uv project and lock file resolve reproducibly.

subtasks.title: Add lint/test/fixture commands
subtasks.done_when: Formatting, lint and unit tests have documented Make targets.

subtasks.title: Prove isolated setup
subtasks.done_when: A clean environment passes the advertised commands.

tasks.title: Add dependency, action, and credential safety checks
tasks.deliverable: Pinned actions, locked dependencies, dedicated secret/history scanning and least-privilege CI policy.
acceptance: PR code never receives secrets/write permissions; privileged events cannot execute fork code.
Credential scanner checks tracked tree/history and public artifacts with reviewed false positives.

subtasks.title: Define trust-separated CI permissions
subtasks.done_when: No elevated fork checkout or untrusted privileged execution exists.

subtasks.title: Pin and scan supply chain/public data
subtasks.done_when: Action SHAs, dependency locks and credential scanning run in CI.

subtasks.title: Test malicious contribution scenarios
subtasks.done_when: A fork PR cannot deploy, write state, or access credentials.

tasks.title: Clear brand, code license, and policy copy
tasks.deliverable: Working-name checks, explicit code license, attribution/disclaimer/privacy/corrections copy.
acceptance: Name/domain/trademark checks and unofficial presentation are recorded; no Nintendo assets are copied.
Code licensing is explicit and separate from publisher content rights; private contact/account details stay private.

subtasks.title: Check Wrap Brief name and independent identity
subtasks.done_when: Evidence supports selected name or a documented rename before launch.

subtasks.title: Select project license and contribution terms
subtasks.done_when: License scope is clear and excludes third-party content.

subtasks.title: Write privacy, source, correction and disclaimer copy
subtasks.done_when: Reader-facing policy text accurately reflects the no-tracking pilot.

tasks.title: Implement versioned source/item/cluster contracts
tasks.deliverable: Typed versioned public records, invariants and source registry schema.
acceptance: Unknown dates remain null/first-seen labeled; URLs and cross-record references validate.
Schema distinguishes source text, original editorial text, rumor/correction status and health.

subtasks.title: Define minimal record and registry fields
subtasks.done_when: Data contracts match the architecture without full text/private fields.

subtasks.title: Implement validation and serialization
subtasks.done_when: Invalid IDs, URLs, dates and references fail with bounded errors.

subtasks.title: Add schema/version fixtures
subtasks.done_when: Producers and consumers share tested stable fixtures.

tasks.title: Approve the first 3–5 sources
tasks.deliverable: Small enabled source registry with reviewed rights/retention/attribution evidence.
acceptance: Every enabled source has terms review date, permitted fields, polling and archival approval.
Unclear permission disables the source; no RSS-is-a-license assumption or unlicensed images.
The same approval-plus-fixture checklist supports a later source addition or disablement without an unrelated pipeline change.

subtasks.title: Select complementary pilot sources
subtasks.done_when: Candidate feasibility is resolved and final feed URLs/coverage scope are documented.

subtasks.title: Approve exact fields, attribution and history retention
subtasks.done_when: Every enabled source has dated rights evidence compatible with the public-state design; unclear rights mean disabled.

subtasks.title: Activate and document repeatable onboarding
subtasks.done_when: Three to five cleared feeds, or an explicitly smaller viable pilot, pass registry checks and a source addition/disable dry-run recipe.

tasks.title: Build synthetic feed and view-model fixtures
tasks.deliverable: Rights-safe RSS/Atom, hostile input, and renderer fixtures with injected clocks.
acceptance: Offline fixtures cover valid, empty, malformed, hostile and timezone cases.
No copied article bodies, real tokens, contact emails or private headers appear in fixtures.

subtasks.title: Create representative RSS/Atom fixtures
subtasks.done_when: Namespaces, Unicode, missing dates/GUIDs and updates are represented.

subtasks.title: Create adversarial/edge fixtures
subtasks.done_when: Redirect, encoding, XML expansion, limits and duplicate cases are synthetic.

subtasks.title: Publish shared fixture contract
subtasks.done_when: Data and UI lanes can work independently on identical expected models.

tasks.title: Check source feasibility before substantial prototype work
tasks.deliverable: Lightweight evidence that a viable reduced source set permits the proposed title/link/metadata and public-history use; final activation remains T02.02.
acceptance: Review at least three complementary candidate feeds before substantial data/UI implementation; reduce scope or stop if no lawful viable set exists.
Record rights/retention uncertainties and a go/no-go without copying private correspondence or claiming final source approval.

subtasks.title: Inventory candidate feeds and terms
subtasks.done_when: Candidate ownership, URLs and intended reuse can be assessed without implementing the collector.

subtasks.title: Check minimum viable rights and retention fit
subtasks.done_when: There is evidence for a viable reduced source set or a documented no-go before substantial M1 work.

subtasks.title: Record go/no-go and hand off to final onboarding
subtasks.done_when: T02.02 receives unresolved terms, attribution, retention and coverage questions for final approval.

tasks.title: Implement bounded safe feed HTTP client
tasks.deliverable: Allowlisted HTTPS requests with limits, conditional headers, timeout and backoff.
acceptance: Every redirect/destination is checked; private/metadata targets, oversized bodies and unsafe URLs are rejected.
Request concurrency/retry budgets respect source policies and do not leak headers in logs.

subtasks.title: Implement safe destination and redirect validation
subtasks.done_when: Only approved hosts/public HTTPS targets can be requested.

subtasks.title: Implement bounded transport and conditional GET
subtasks.done_when: Timeouts, decompressed byte limit, redirects, retries and 304 are handled.

subtasks.title: Test abuse and partial-source failures
subtasks.done_when: One malicious/slow feed cannot monopolize the run or erase other data.

tasks.title: Parse RSS and Atom safely
tasks.deliverable: Pure RSS/Atom adapters using a safe locked XML dependency where justified.
acceptance: External entities/DTD/expansion are disabled; depth/text/item bounds apply.
Parser emits source metadata only, never raw HTML/full article/enclosure downloads.

subtasks.title: Implement small RSS/Atom adapters
subtasks.done_when: Supported feed formats return the shared candidate record shape.

subtasks.title: Enforce safe XML and field bounds
subtasks.done_when: Hostile entities, nesting and oversized text fail safely.

subtasks.title: Test format and encoding edge cases
subtasks.done_when: Fixture suite passes offline with predictable item quarantine.

tasks.title: Normalize and validate public metadata
tasks.deliverable: Plain-text safe URLs/titles, explicit UTC, provenance, and item quarantine.
acceptance: Publication/update/first-seen times remain distinct; ambiguous dates are not fabricated.
Unsafe links/markup and unapproved fields cannot reach state or rendered output.

subtasks.title: Normalize text, URLs and source references
subtasks.done_when: Public fields meet length/scheme/provenance constraints.

subtasks.title: Normalize UTC and unknown/future dates
subtasks.done_when: Dates and labels retain honest semantics under injected clocks.

subtasks.title: Test escaping/quarantine paths
subtasks.done_when: Invalid entries are bounded and reported without losing valid entries.

tasks.title: Add incremental polling, health and gap detection
tasks.deliverable: Per-source checkpoints, 304 handling, last-good fallback and possible truncation warnings.
acceptance: Checkpoints advance only after validated source success; legitimate no-news is not a failure.
Potential missed feed windows and partial/all-source failures are surfaced honestly.

subtasks.title: Persist conditional-request checkpoints
subtasks.done_when: ETag/Last-Modified and poll boundaries survive independent runs.

subtasks.title: Implement healthy/degraded/no-new outcomes
subtasks.done_when: Source errors preserve prior records; all-source failure stops publication.

subtasks.title: Detect possible feed-window gaps
subtasks.done_when: Truncation fixtures produce warnings without false completeness claims.

tasks.title: Implement full normalized snapshot store
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic local snapshot read/validate/write API and retained complete records.
acceptance: State stores complete metadata and checkpoints, not only seen IDs.
Identical inputs produce stable IDs/order; schema and references reject corrupt snapshots.

subtasks.title: Implement snapshot serialization and validation
subtasks.done_when: Versioned complete records round-trip deterministically.

subtasks.title: Implement idempotent update/tombstone semantics
subtasks.done_when: Repeated items do not duplicate or become artificially fresh.

subtasks.title: Test cache/artifact independence
subtasks.done_when: Loss of optional caches does not change identity or retained records.

tasks.title: Implement isolated state-branch CAS persistence
tasks.deliverable: Trusted default-branch writer with exact data allowlist and expected-head fast-forward commits.
acceptance: Writer rejects path traversal, symlinks, executable/workflow/config artifacts and invalid/oversized JSON.
No force push or main bypass; conflict causes safe bounded retry/failure under shared concurrency.

subtasks.title: Define state branch rules and writer contract
subtasks.done_when: Actual branch protections support intended writes without main bypass.

subtasks.title: Implement revalidation and expected-parent commit
subtasks.done_when: Only bounded allowed public JSON paths can be committed.

subtasks.title: Exercise conflict and hostile candidate scenarios
subtasks.done_when: CAS conflicts and injected executable/path payloads fail safely.

tasks.title: Test state retention, migrations and component recovery
tasks.deliverable: Component-level retention, schema migration, replay and failed-build recovery tests; operational site rollback belongs to T07.05.
acceptance: State committed before a failed build remains available to the next complete build.
Retention/tombstones are rights-aware; Git-history permanence is explicit and restore preserves IDs.

subtasks.title: Implement bounded retention and tombstones
subtasks.done_when: Expired/resurfaced/retracted records follow explicit non-fabricated freshness rules.

subtasks.title: Implement migration and known-good restore
subtasks.done_when: Previous state version/snapshot restores with validated records/checkpoints.

subtasks.title: Simulate failure after state commit
subtasks.done_when: Next build includes every retained item without depending on a lost artifact.

tasks.title: Compose explicit collect/build/check CLI stages
tasks.deliverable: Composable stage commands, dry run, injected time/network and safe manifest/exit codes.
acceptance: Each stage has explicit input/output contracts and can run from fixtures independently.
Dry run performs no state mutation/deployment; partial failures are represented in bounded health.

subtasks.title: Implement orchestration over pure modules
subtasks.done_when: Stages do not mix network, grouping, persistence and rendering concerns.

subtasks.title: Add dry-run and safe manifest output
subtasks.done_when: Outputs identify code/config/state and health without private fields.

subtasks.title: Test whole-pipeline replay and failure exits
subtasks.done_when: Fixture pipeline is deterministic and returns actionable bounded failures.

tasks.title: Implement exact identity and conservative URL cleanup
tasks.deliverable: Source-scoped stable identity and reviewed tracking-parameter normalization.
acceptance: Tracking variants deduplicate; article-identifying query fields remain distinct.
Source GUID collisions/changes do not silently overwrite unrelated articles.

subtasks.title: Define GUID/URL identity precedence
subtasks.done_when: Identity rules are deterministic and versioned.

subtasks.title: Implement reviewed URL normalization
subtasks.done_when: Only known tracking parameters are stripped.

subtasks.title: Test duplicate/collision/resurfacing cases
subtasks.done_when: Same item is stable while distinct editions/events remain separate.

tasks.title: Group same-event coverage and choose lead source
tasks.deliverable: Conservative event clusters, stable IDs, deterministic evidence-based lead ranking.
acceptance: Rumor/confirmation, distinct Direct announcements, reviews and news do not collapse blindly.
All alternate members retain links/provenance; commercial value never affects ranking.

subtasks.title: Implement bounded similarity candidate stage
subtasks.done_when: Entities/event types/time window constrain title similarity.

subtasks.title: Implement stable groups and transparent lead choice
subtasks.done_when: Primary/original/substantive coverage rules have deterministic tie-breakers.

subtasks.title: Test ambiguous and conflicting coverage
subtasks.done_when: Uncertain matches split; rumors/corrections retain explicit labels.

tasks.title: Benchmark grouping and add reviewed split/merge overrides
tasks.deliverable: Labeled benchmark, measured precision/recall, reversible manual corrections.
acceptance: At least 100 labeled pairs include known hard cases; automatic merge precision is at least 98% on sample.
Overrides are reviewed, deterministic and traceable; fuzzy grouping can be disabled safely.

subtasks.title: Label representative real-event metadata pairs
subtasks.done_when: Rights-safe benchmark covers event/edition/rumor/correction edge cases.

subtasks.title: Measure and tune conservative thresholds
subtasks.done_when: Precision, recall, sample size and false merges are reported.

subtasks.title: Implement split/merge and disable controls
subtasks.done_when: Reviewed overrides survive reruns without deleting source provenance.

tasks.title: Add provenance, corrections and takedown controls
tasks.deliverable: Source-attribution, correction/retraction and removal controls; no original-brief production system required for MVP.
acceptance: Publisher headlines remain explicitly attributed; an MVP listing never implies original reporting or fabricated editorial context.
A correction/removal exercise preserves honest provenance, prevents re-promotion and addresses public-state/history rights constraints.

subtasks.title: Preserve publisher and claim provenance
subtasks.done_when: Attribution and confirmed/reported/rumor labels have explicit source evidence; absent editorial text stays absent.

subtasks.title: Implement correction/retraction and exclusion controls
subtasks.done_when: Withdrawn or changed claims cannot remain silently promoted and overrides retain traceable provenance.

subtasks.title: Exercise source-requested removal
subtasks.done_when: The chosen remedy handles tombstones/retention and does not falsely claim file deletion erases public Git history.

tasks.title: Create responsive visual tokens and semantic shell
tasks.deliverable: Original minimalist mobile-first shell, typography, spacing and contrast-tested colors.
acceptance: No copied Nintendo identity/assets, external fonts or required client framework.
Semantic landmarks, skip link, visible focus and readable 320px layout are present.

subtasks.title: Translate UX spec into a small token set
subtasks.done_when: Typography, spacing and accent colors pass contrast targets.

subtasks.title: Build semantic responsive shell
subtasks.done_when: Header/content/footer reflow cleanly from mobile to desktop.

subtasks.title: Validate long text and focus states
subtasks.done_when: No clipped links/labels or invisible keyboard focus.

tasks.title: Render grouped digest with accessible alternate sources
tasks.deliverable: Escaped static story cards with lead links, native disclosures and honest labels.
acceptance: Core reading and all source links work with JavaScript disabled.
Title/source/known time/rumor status are visible; other coverage remains reachable by keyboard.

subtasks.title: Implement pure view models and HTML escaping
subtasks.done_when: Hostile source fields render as safe text/links.

subtasks.title: Implement cards and native coverage disclosure
subtasks.done_when: Lead action and alternate publishers have descriptive links.

subtasks.title: Build deterministic fixture homepage
subtasks.done_when: Same supplied inputs/clock yield identical output files.

tasks.title: Render policies, honest health and empty/degraded states
tasks.deliverable: About/sources/privacy/corrections, absolute check time and safe empty/stale states.
acceptance: Failed feeds are not described as no news; no-JS readers always see the absolute check timestamp.
30-hour stale behavior is truthful, including limits of static HTML and any optional local-clock enhancement.

subtasks.title: Render methodology and required policy links
subtasks.done_when: Independent status, rights, privacy and correction route are reachable.

subtasks.title: Implement healthy/empty/degraded states
subtasks.done_when: Source failures and genuine zero-new-news have different copy.

subtasks.title: Implement/test freshness display
subtasks.done_when: Publication, first-seen, last-check and deployment times are not conflated.

tasks.title: Prove core accessibility and performance budgets
tasks.deliverable: Repeatable browser/a11y/no-JS and compressed-size checks against fixture site.
acceptance: 320px, desktop, keyboard, screen-reader checks, 200/400% reflow and reduced-motion behavior pass.
Initial HTML/CSS/JS <=150 KB compressed; mobile LCP/CLS targets measured with environment noted.

subtasks.title: Add repeatable browser/static checks
subtasks.done_when: Core read/expand/outbound tasks are tested without JS and by keyboard.

subtasks.title: Measure size and mobile rendering
subtasks.done_when: Compressed payload, LCP/CLS and test environment are recorded.

subtasks.title: Fix UX/a11y regressions
subtasks.done_when: No release-blocking overflow, contrast, focus or source-navigation failure remains.

tasks.title: Wire credential-free PR CI and full fixture build
tasks.deliverable: Required read-only lint/unit/fixture/schema/render/workflow checks on pull requests.
acceptance: Fork PR check paths cannot mutate state/deploy or obtain secrets.
CI rejects invalid source/config/grouping/output and generated-plan drift.

subtasks.title: Assemble named required checks
subtasks.done_when: Lint, unit, integration, schemas, HTML/links and plan checks have stable names.

subtasks.title: Run fixture build on fork PR
subtasks.done_when: No production network credentials or write scopes are needed.

subtasks.title: Test intentionally failing changes
subtasks.done_when: Broken contracts/unsafe workflows are blocked before merge.

tasks.title: Schedule daily collection and isolated persistence
tasks.deliverable: Default-branch daily/manual collect -> validate -> persist pipeline with one mutation lock.
acceptance: Only cron 23 6 * * * is enabled initially; UTC/cadence and manual default-branch restrictions are explicit.
Read-only fetch and trusted state-write jobs are separated; all-source failure/conflict cannot corrupt state.

subtasks.title: Configure schedule/manual triggers and lock
subtasks.done_when: All production mutation/recovery routes share concurrency control.

subtasks.title: Wire bounded collect and data-only writer artifact
subtasks.done_when: Privileged job revalidates the exact approved candidate contract.

subtasks.title: Run real-source dry run and persistence sandbox
subtasks.done_when: Approved source polling and state boundaries pass without deploying.

tasks.title: Deploy validated static artifact through protected Pages
tasks.deliverable: Read-only build from explicit state/code refs, one-day Pages artifact, restricted OIDC deploy.
acceptance: Deploy job has Pages/OIDC permissions only and runs after every build gate.
Invalid/empty-on-failure output cannot replace live site; actual public URL/manifest is smoke-tested.

subtasks.title: Configure Pages source and environment restrictions
subtasks.done_when: Only reviewed default-branch releases can deploy.

subtasks.title: Wire build/validate/upload/deploy jobs
subtasks.done_when: Artifact root, entry point, retention and manifest are correct.

subtasks.title: Exercise successful and failed publication
subtasks.done_when: Known-good site survives a pre-deploy failure; live output matches manifest.

tasks.title: Add health reporting and supervised pilot checks
tasks.deliverable: Public minimal health manifest, failed-job notifications and a named daily supervision procedure; independent monitoring gates later unattended mode.
acceptance: A named maintainer role checks freshness/source health daily and records escalation for a 30-hour stale result; a disabled schedule is not assumed self-monitoring.
Alerts and health omit credentials/private contacts; pilot is explicitly supervised until independent stale monitoring is proven.

subtasks.title: Emit bounded collection/source/deployment health
subtasks.done_when: Manifest distinguishes successful collection, deployment, source failures and possible feed gaps.

subtasks.title: Define named daily supervision and failure notification
subtasks.done_when: Maintainer role, daily check, 30-hour threshold and escalation are documented without publishing private contacts.

subtasks.title: Exercise failed and disabled schedule detection
subtasks.done_when: Supervised checks notice stale/missed runs; no claim of unattended operation is made. Independent monitoring moves to T11.01.

tasks.title: Rehearse known-good rollback and state restore
tasks.deliverable: One end-to-end operational rollback/restore drill with reviewed code/state refs and reusable public-safe evidence.
acceptance: Rollback does not depend only on expiring artifacts and does not erase valid unseen state.
Practical restore time is measured against a 30-minute target and public URL is checked.
T08.04 and the release checklist reference this drill; they do not rerun it unless inputs or recovery behavior change.

subtasks.title: Implement guarded manual recovery route
subtasks.done_when: Only reviewed refs can be selected under the same production lock.

subtasks.title: Restore known-good site and state in sandbox
subtasks.done_when: IDs/checkpoints/tombstones and live manifest remain coherent.

subtasks.title: Record operational recovery evidence
subtasks.done_when: Elapsed time, outcomes, resume criteria and residual limitations are documented.

tasks.title: Complete adversarial and public-surface security review
tasks.deliverable: Threat-driven tests and scan evidence across repo/history/state/artifacts/logs/output.
acceptance: Unsafe feed URLs/XML/HTML/artifact paths and privileged fork scenarios are rejected.
No credentials, user/payment data, private contact fields or runtime state is published.

subtasks.title: Test input and privilege attack paths
subtasks.done_when: SSRF, XML abuse, XSS, writer traversal and fork escalation cases pass.

subtasks.title: Inspect all public publication surfaces
subtasks.done_when: Dedicated scanner plus manual classification review finds no unresolved secret.

subtasks.title: Resolve high-severity findings
subtasks.done_when: Security review signs off the actual integrated release candidate.

tasks.title: Validate the integrated reader flow with users
tasks.deliverable: Observed reader tasks, accessibility/performance results and repaired usability failures.
acceptance: At least five representative sessions test check time, rumor, source comparison and publisher navigation.
Core mobile/keyboard/no-JS flow and performance guardrails pass on the integrated candidate.

subtasks.title: Prepare realistic story scenarios
subtasks.done_when: Long headlines, rumors, corrections, many sources and stale/empty states are covered.

subtasks.title: Observe reader tasks and accessibility
subtasks.done_when: Findings distinguish observed behavior from assumptions.

subtasks.title: Repair and recheck material failures
subtasks.done_when: No blocker remains in core comprehension or outbound reading.

tasks.title: Release and verify the daily public pilot
tasks.deliverable: Noncommercial pilot release with cleared sources, live checks and first scheduled cycle evidence.
acceptance: All prerequisite MVP tasks and source/brand/security/recovery gates pass; no tracking or monetization is enabled.
Actual Pages site and next scheduled cycle are checked; supervised ownership and limitations are visible.
Any security-relevant change after T08.01 receives a scoped delta review before release; this task does not require its own prior completion.

subtasks.title: Audit integrated launch checklist
subtasks.done_when: Prerequisite evidence is complete and changes since final security review have been checked; T08.03 itself is completed only after release verification.

subtasks.title: Publish and smoke-check pilot
subtasks.done_when: Public URL has expected content, links, policies, safe state and freshness.

subtasks.title: Verify next daily cycle and handoff
subtasks.done_when: Scheduled update, alerts and operator runbook work in live operation.

tasks.title: Review contributor/operator handoff using existing evidence
tasks.deliverable: Usable contributor and incident handoff referencing existing security/recovery evidence rather than duplicating drills.
acceptance: A maintainer can follow source-disable, failure-triage and restore instructions using the evidence owned by T07.05 and T08.01.
Public contributor instructions are verified against the existing T01.02 clean-clone result; only changed steps are rerun.

subtasks.title: Assign routine maintenance and incident ownership
subtasks.done_when: Weekly source/quality/cost reviews and escalation have an accountable maintainer role.

subtasks.title: Review runbooks against existing drills
subtasks.done_when: Links to T07.05 recovery and T08.01 security evidence are correct; no redundant restore tabletop is required.

subtasks.title: Check contributor documentation against clean-clone evidence
subtasks.done_when: Instructions match T01.02 setup and current CI; rerun only behavior changed since that evidence.

tasks.title: Decide measurement approach; instrument only if approved
tasks.deliverable: Evidence-based no-tracking or approved-minimal-measurement decision with honest metrics and privacy controls.
acceptance: A documented no-tracking decision is a valid completion outcome; operational, editorial-output, workload and cash-cost metrics can support M3.
Any instrumentation has provider/data/legal/performance review; unique-reader/retention/attribution claims require an actually approved method.

subtasks.title: Choose no-tracking or minimal approved provider
subtasks.done_when: Data categories, region/consent basis, retention and access are recorded.

subtasks.title: Implement only if approved, or document no-tracking
subtasks.done_when: No-tracking remains the default; any chosen instrumentation stays within approved consent/data/performance boundaries.

subtasks.title: Validate counts and honest reporting
subtasks.done_when: Known test events match documented metric denominators/limitations.

tasks.title: Publish original digest, public RSS and selective SEO
tasks.deliverable: Original-brief model and review workflow, useful recurring editorial content, public RSS and quality-first search metadata.
acceptance: Only substantive original/curated pages are indexed; no thin per-keyword page explosion.
Canonical/sitemap/robots/feed links are accurate and all publisher attribution is preserved.

subtasks.title: Implement and publish a reviewed original digest
subtasks.done_when: Original briefs have a minimal content model, byline, cited sources and review state; sustainable effort is recorded separately from MVP source listings.

subtasks.title: Add RSS and accurate discovery metadata
subtasks.done_when: Feed, canonical, sitemap and share metadata validate without unlicensed assets.

subtasks.title: Review indexability and acquisition channels
subtasks.done_when: Thin/duplicate pages are excluded and community sharing follows rules.

tasks.title: Establish four-week reader-value and cost baseline
tasks.deliverable: Four-week aggregate reliability, quality, reader-value and operator-effort report.
acceptance: Report actual available metrics and missing-data limitations, not invented retention.
Cash costs and operator minutes have reproducible definitions and a sustainable workload cap.

subtasks.title: Collect four weeks of approved observations
subtasks.done_when: Reliability, source quality, editorial effort and measured audience data are complete enough to interpret.

subtasks.title: Compute contribution and workload baseline
subtasks.done_when: Fees/tools/time are included with an explicit operator rate.

subtasks.title: Decide next smallest improvement
subtasks.done_when: Keep/change/stop decision cites reader value and actual cost.

tasks.title: Run one ethical engagement experiment
tasks.deliverable: One time-boxed experiment such as digest placement or source navigation, with guardrails.
acceptance: Hypothesis, time/cash cap, measurement method and stop/rollback rule precede implementation.
No modal/forced signup/dark pattern; source referrals, accessibility and performance are protected.

subtasks.title: Select one evidence-led engagement change
subtasks.done_when: Baseline supports the chosen reader problem.

subtasks.title: Ship a small reversible experiment
subtasks.done_when: Only approved data and an accessible no-JS baseline are used.

subtasks.title: Evaluate and keep/change/stop
subtasks.done_when: Observed benefit and operator cost determine the result.

tasks.title: Resolve commercial hosting, provider and financial gates
tasks.deliverable: Public-safe go/no-go decision for hosting, provider terms, disclosures, privacy and financial obligations.
acceptance: Pages commercial-use uncertainty is resolved appropriately or hosting migrates before money features.
Provider account/secrets and private tax/payment details are never committed.

subtasks.title: Review current hosting and provider policies
subtasks.done_when: Document compatible use or select/migrate to an appropriate host.

subtasks.title: Complete private account/financial setup
subtasks.done_when: Required verification, fee/tax obligations and private credential storage are addressed.

subtasks.title: Approve public disclosures and experiment cap
subtasks.done_when: Integration is permitted, transparent, reversible and budgeted.

tasks.title: Enable one quiet hosted support option
tasks.deliverable: Optional honest support callout linking to an approved hosted payment provider.
acceptance: No payment details collected on Pages; no default recurring charge, guilt or blocking popup.
Support provider is disclosed and core performance/accessibility/referral tasks remain intact.

subtasks.title: Design minimal support placement and copy
subtasks.done_when: One nonintrusive callout follows reader value and explains use of funds.

subtasks.title: Integrate approved hosted support flow
subtasks.done_when: Only reviewed public URLs/IDs ship; private payment state stays with provider.

subtasks.title: Test success/failure/disable paths
subtasks.done_when: No sensitive data leaks and removal is a small configuration change.

tasks.title: Pilot disclosed affiliate commerce or sponsorship
tasks.deliverable: Only one selected later commercial pilot with useful original content and clear separation.
acceptance: Program/contract/provider rules are reviewed; disclosures appear before clicks and no source ranking is sold.
Audience claims are truthful and contribution is evaluated after operator time.

subtasks.title: Choose channel based on audience evidence
subtasks.done_when: Affiliate purchase intent or sponsor fit has a reasoned business case.

subtasks.title: Ship separated disclosed content/placement
subtasks.done_when: No editorial card or lead ranking masquerades as paid promotion.

subtasks.title: Evaluate contribution and trust guardrails
subtasks.done_when: Keep/change/stop decision includes fees/time and user impact.

tasks.title: Evaluate support conversion and net contribution
tasks.deliverable: Time-boxed support experiment result and explicit expand/stop decision.
acceptance: Gross donations are not called profit; fees, tools and operator hours are subtracted.
Conversion is reported only with valid exposure measurement; otherwise raw totals/limitations are shown.

subtasks.title: Collect approved aggregate support outcomes
subtasks.done_when: No donor records or private provider exports enter the repo.

subtasks.title: Calculate net contribution and workload
subtasks.done_when: Operator rate, expenses and measurement limits are explicit.

subtasks.title: Choose keep/change/stop before expansion
subtasks.done_when: Negative economics or trust/performance harm can disable the channel.

tasks.title: Evaluate and optionally pilot display advertising
tasks.deliverable: Ad go/no-go and, only if approved, a bounded labeled placement with consent controls.
acceptance: Hosting/network/original-content/privacy/consent approval precedes scripts.
Reserved dimensions, Advertisement labels, no-ad fallback and before/after performance/referral checks pass.

subtasks.title: Validate commercial and network eligibility
subtasks.done_when: Thin aggregation alone is not assumed sufficient for approval.

subtasks.title: Pilot one safe placement or record no-go
subtasks.done_when: No deceptive card placement, behavioral tracking by default or layout shift.

subtasks.title: Measure return after all costs and harms
subtasks.done_when: Ads are removed if contribution/reader-value guardrails fail.

tasks.title: Expand cadence, sources or unattended operation with evidence
tasks.deliverable: A selected expansion: twice-daily polling, additional approved sources, or independently monitored unattended operation.
acceptance: Feed gaps, freshness or operator workload justify the chosen change; no expansion is required just because public compute is free.
Before unattended mode, an independent monitor detects a disabled schedule at a 30-hour threshold using an approved private notification route.
Additional sources/cadence still meet rights, quality and request budgets; rollback and incremental cost are documented.

subtasks.title: Select one observed coverage or workload problem
subtasks.done_when: Evidence supports cadence/source expansion or reducing manual supervision; no automatic expansion is assumed.

subtasks.title: Implement only the selected bounded change
subtasks.done_when: Use one approved cron/source set; unattended mode requires a separately verified independent monitor and private notification route.

subtasks.title: Compare value, cost and missed-schedule behavior
subtasks.done_when: Coverage/workload improves without trust/rights regressions; disabled-schedule detection is proven before claiming unattended operation.

tasks.title: Select one discovery feature: search, game page or calendar
tasks.deliverable: One modular static discovery feature backed by demand, not a full portal rewrite.
acceptance: New pages provide unique value; no empty keyword doorway pages or backend dependency without need.
Core no-JS reading, performance and source attribution remain intact.

subtasks.title: Choose and refine the highest-value discovery need
subtasks.done_when: Reader baseline supports search, selected game page or release calendar.

subtasks.title: Implement against existing view models
subtasks.done_when: Ingestion/state contracts do not need an unnecessary rewrite.

subtasks.title: Measure usage and maintenance burden
subtasks.done_when: Feature is retained only if value exceeds its operating complexity.

tasks.title: Add consented email digest only after demonstrated demand
tasks.deliverable: Approved provider-based newsletter with consent, unsubscribe, private storage and portability.
acceptance: Subscriber/suppression lists never enter Git/Pages; signup and unsubscribe work securely.
Free-tier limits, consent/retention/privacy, export/exit and workload are reviewed.

subtasks.title: Validate demand and choose bounded provider
subtasks.done_when: Cost, deliverability, privacy and migration options are documented.

subtasks.title: Implement consent and lifecycle via provider
subtasks.done_when: Signup/confirmation/unsubscribe/deletion work without a custom public data store.

subtasks.title: Pilot digest and measure sustainable value
subtasks.done_when: No scraped outreach or misleading subscriber metrics; stop/exit path is proven.

tasks.title: Migrate storage or hosting when policy/limits require it
tasks.deliverable: Portable static host/state backend migration preserving public IDs, URLs and recovery.
acceptance: Policy, retention/erasure, state growth or reliability need is measured and budgeted.
Dual-read/restore verification and cutover rollback protect content, tombstones, links and credentials.

subtasks.title: Define migration trigger and target
subtasks.done_when: Provider terms/cost/retention and secret boundaries satisfy the actual need.

subtasks.title: Migrate snapshots/URLs with validation
subtasks.done_when: IDs, records, checkpoints and public links remain consistent.

subtasks.title: Rehearse cutover and rollback
subtasks.done_when: Known-good site/state restore is proven before irreversible cleanup.

tasks.title: Evaluate advanced grouping or localization as a separate slice
tasks.deliverable: Refined evidence-led experiment, not automatic AI/multilingual scope expansion.
acceptance: Benchmark gain or reader demand justifies cost, rights and editorial complexity.
Baseline deterministic pipeline still works without paid services; language/rumor/correction semantics remain accurate.

subtasks.title: Select one concrete quality or language problem
subtasks.done_when: Baseline metrics support a narrow experiment with an explicit budget.

subtasks.title: Prototype behind disabled-by-default configuration
subtasks.done_when: Provider/privacy/translation rights and fallback are reviewed before use.

subtasks.title: Compare quality, cost and operational burden
subtasks.done_when: Only a measurable improvement proceeds; failed experiment is removed cleanly.
